open_points.subject: FlowEdge guard propagation and NodeExecution status
open_points.question: Does “skipped node” mean only a source recorded `skipped_by_guard`, or does it also include a source recorded `upstream_failed`?
open_points.default_guess: Only a source recorded `skipped_by_guard`; failure-derived non-execution continues to produce `upstream_failed`.

open_points.subject: NodeExecution status when guard skipping and upstream failure coincide
open_points.text: M15 says “A node one of whose input ports has every incoming edge disabled by its guard, or coming from a skipped node, is not executed and is recorded `skipped_by_guard`”; M23 separately records a node not executed because “an upstream node failed” as `upstream_failed`.
open_points.question: When one input port is unavailable through disabled guards or skipped sources while another dependency is unavailable because of an upstream failure, is the node recorded `skipped_by_guard` or `upstream_failed`?
options: Record `skipped_by_guard` whenever the new per-input-port guard condition holds.
Record `upstream_failed` whenever any upstream failure also prevents execution.
Choose according to whichever condition is observed first.
open_points.default_guess: Record `upstream_failed` whenever an upstream failure is among the causes; otherwise record `skipped_by_guard`.

open_points.subject: Guard skipping for an input port also supplied by a FlowConstant
open_points.text: M15 tests whether an input port has “every incoming edge disabled by its guard, or coming from a skipped node,” while M16 says a FlowConstant is “delivered to one input port like any other value.”
open_points.question: If a port has a delivered FlowConstant but all of its incoming FlowEdges are disabled or come from skipped nodes, is the node executed using the constant or recorded `skipped_by_guard`?
options: The delivered constant satisfies the port, so the node is not skipped for that port.
The edge-only condition controls, so the node is `skipped_by_guard` despite the constant.
Composition forbids a constant and any incoming edge from targeting the same port.
open_points.default_guess: Composition forbids a constant and any incoming edge from targeting the same input port.
